## Concrete change

Describe the new outcome or correction and why it belongs here.

## Primary evidence

Link the maintainer's documentation or original demo supporting the claim. State what was source-reviewed and what, if anything, you personally tested.

## Validation

- [ ] Data follows the schema, includes limits, and is sorted.
- [ ] Review dates reflect a real source review.
- [ ] `make build` and `make verify` pass.
- [ ] Images/demo links have provenance; no unsupported compatibility claims.
